sources.snippet: sae-gemma-4-e4b-it-topk-l21 A TopK sparse autoencoder for google/gemma-4-E4B-it, residual-stream layer 21 (d_in=2560, d_sae=40960, k=64, FVU=0.2717). Trained with the v2 recipe (BOS-drop + per-dim standardization) for The Refusal Slope: A Mechanistic Taxonomy of Feature Fate in Quantized Edge Intelligence (M. Elrashid, BUiD).

sources.snippet: A SAE safety gate for google/gemma-4-E4B-it (MatFormer, multimodal): logistic regression over sparse-autoencoder features of the layer-21 residual stream, scoring P (harmful) from the prompt before generation.
